approved_classes.ex:AminoAcid: A class representing an amino acid.
approved_classes.ex:EssentialAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that are not produced by the body and must be obtained through food.
approved_classes.ex:NonEssentialAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that can be synthesized by the body.
approved_classes.ex:SemiEssentialAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that is produced in the body but insufficiently, requiring dietary supplementation.
approved_classes.ex:AliphaticAminoAcid: A class representing aliphatic amino acids with simple side chains.
approved_classes.ex:BranchedChainAminoAcid: A subclass of AliphaticAminoAcid that has branched aliphatic side chains.
approved_classes.ex:HydroxylGroupContainingAminoAcid: A class representing amino acids with hydroxyl groups in their side chains.
approved_classes.ex:SulphurContainingAminoAcid: A class representing amino acids containing sulfur in their side chains.
approved_classes.ex:AcidicAminoAcid: A class representing acidic amino acids with carboxyl groups.
approved_classes.ex:BasicAminoAcid: A class representing basic amino acids with guanidino or imidazole rings.
approved_classes.ex:AromaticAminoAcid: A class representing aromatic amino acids with indole or benzene rings in their side chains.
approved_classes.ex:IminoAminoAcid: A class representing imino acids with an imino group instead of a primary amine.
approved_classes.ex:HeterocyclicAminoAcid: A class representing amino acids containing heterocyclic rings in their side chains.
approved_classes.ex:PurelyKetogenicAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that can be used to make fat and are completely ketogenic.
approved_classes.ex:KetogenicAndGlucogenicAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that has both ketogenic and glucogenic metabolic fates.
approved_classes.ex:PurelyGlucogenicAminoAcid: A subclass of AminoAcid that can be used as a starting point for glucose production.
approved_classes.ex:NonPolarAminoAcid: A class representing non-polar amino acids with no charge on the R group.
approved_classes.ex:PolarAminoAcidWithNoChargeOnRGroup: A subclass of PolarAminoAcid that has an uncharged R group but contributes to hydrogen bonding.
approved_classes.ex:PolarAminoAcidWithPositiveChargeOnRGr: A subclass of PolarAminoAcid with a positively charged R group.
approved_classes.ex:PolarAminoAcidWithNegativeChargeOnRGr: A subclass of PolarAminoAcid with a negatively charged R group.
approved_classes.http://example.org/classes/AminoAcidHydr: A class representing the process of amino acid hydrolysis to produce a specific amino acid.
approved_classes.http://example.org/classes/PhthalimideSy: A class for the method involving treating an alpha halogenated acid ester with potassium phthalimide to produce a substituted phthalimide, which when hydrolyzed yields phthalic acid and amino acid.
approved_classes.http://example.org/classes/AminoAcidDrug: A class for non-standard amino acids used as drugs.

ex:isEssential.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is essential or not.

ex:hasSideChain.comment: The side chain of the amino acid.

ex:isProducedByBody.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is produced by the body or not.

ex:hasMeltingPoint.comment: The melting point of the amino acid.

ex:isSweet.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is sweet or not.

ex:hasTaste.comment: The taste of the amino acid.

ex:isOpticallyActive.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is optically active or not.

ex:hasZwitterionForm.comment: Indicates whether the amino acid can form a zwitterion.

ex:isDecarboxylated.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid undergoes decarboxylation.

ex:formsSaltWithAlkali.comment: The salt formed when the amino acid reacts with alkali.

ex:formsEsterWithAlcohol.comment: The ester formed when the amino acid reacts with alcohol.

ex:reactsWithAmmonia.comment: The amide formed when the amino acid reacts with ammonia.

ex:formsSaltWithMineralAcid.comment: The salt formed when the amino acid reacts with a mineral acid.

ex:reactsWithNinhydrin.comment: The product of the ninhydrin reaction with an amino acid.

ex:classifiesAsAliphaticAminoAcid.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is classified as aliphatic.

ex:classifiesAsBranchedChainAminoAcid.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is a branched-chain aliphatic amino acid.

ex:classifiesAsHydroxylGroupContainingAm.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid contains a hydroxyl group in its side chain.

ex:classifiesAsSulphurContainingAminoAci.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid contains sulfur in its side chain.

ex:classifiesAsAcidicAminoAcid.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is classified as acidic with carboxyl groups.

ex:classifiesAsBasicAminoAcid.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is classified as basic with guanidino or imidazole rings.

ex:classifiesAsAromaticAminoAcid.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is classified as aromatic with indole or benzene rings in its side chain.

ex:classifiesAsIminoAminoAcid.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is classified as imino with an imino group instead of a primary amine.

ex:classifiesAsHeterocyclicAminoAcid.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is classified as heterocyclic with a ring in its side chain.

ex:classifiesAsPurelyKetogenicAminoAcid.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is classified as purely ketogenic and can be used to make fat.

ex:classifiesAsKetogenicAndGlucogenicAmi.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is classified as ketogenic and glucogenic with both metabolic fates.

ex:classifiesAsPurelyGlucogenicAminoAcid.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is classified as purely glucogenic and can be used for glucose production.

ex:classifiesAsNonPolarAminoAcid.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is classified as non-polar with no charge on the R group.

ex:classifiesAsPolarAminoAcidWithNoCharg.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is classified as polar with an uncharged R group.

ex:classifiesAsPolarAminoAcidWithPositiv.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is classified as polar with a positively charged R group.

ex:classifiesAsPolarAminoAcidWithNegativ.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is classified as polar with a negatively charged R group.

http://example.org/properties/usedForTre.comment: A property indicating the treatments for which a specific amino acid is used.

http://example.org/properties/drugApplic.comment: A property indicating the application of non-standard amino acids as drugs.
